INSERT INTO audit_events (
            actor_kind,
            actor_owner_id,
            action,
            outcome,
            target_kind,
            target_id,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            'owner',
            $1,
            'asset.purge',
            'success',
            'asset',
            $2,
            jsonb_build_object('original_removed', $3::boolean)
        )
